Module com.example.sudoku_game
Package com.example.sudoku_game.model

Class Sudoku

java.lang.Object
com.example.sudoku_game.model.Sudoku
All Implemented Interfaces:
ISudoku
public class Sudoku extends Object implements ISudoku
Core mathematical engine implementing the ISudoku interface constraints. This class coordinates the state of a 6x6 Sudoku board using localized matrices managed by hash structures. It features procedural generation via recursive backtracking, grid constraint validation routines, automated clue pruning with protection limits, and solution verification. * @author Alejandro Valencia

  • Method Details

    • generateBoard

      public void generateBoard()
      Resets internal trackers and procedures to populate a brand-new randomized 6x6 Sudoku layout. Fulfills the ISudoku.generateBoard() contract. It triggers recursive matrix filling, clones the generated solution, and passes the board to a pruning process to reveal playable hints.
      Specified by:
      generateBoard in interface ISudoku

    • isValidMove

      public boolean isValidMove(int row, int col, int value)
      Evaluates a digit injection attempt against the traditional Sudoku alignment constraints. Fulfills the ISudoku.isValidMove(int, int, int) contract, evaluating cross-axis conflicts across the entire 6-node length and verifying constraints within localized 2x3 mini-block sectors. * @param row Vertical grid line tracker index boundary (0-5).
      Specified by:
      isValidMove in interface ISudoku
      Parameters:
      col - Horizontal grid line tracker index boundary (0-5).
      value - The numerical digit token candidate being evaluated (1-6).
      Returns:
      true if the placement candidate satisfies all constraints, false if conflicts occur.
